iphone-6.9.notes: Required tier. Capture on iPhone 17 Pro Max simulator.

iphone-6.5.notes: Optional; App Store auto-scales 6.9 if omitted. Same template, smaller canvas.

iphone-duo-outer.notes: iPhone Duo outer (closed) display. Required from April 2027 for apps built with the iOS 27.1 SDK or later; submitting Duo screenshots adds an optimized-for-iPhone-Duo badge to the product page. Window is ~466 dp, so single-pane phone layout. Source: Apple screenshot specifications, checked 2026-10-25.

iphone-duo-inner.notes: iPhone Duo inner (open) display. Same April 2027 requirement and badge; Apple lists both sizes under one entry without saying each needs its own set, so ship both. Portrait is ~669 dp (below the 840 dp dual-pane gate, single pane); only landscape (~951 dp) shows list + map. Capture fully open, where the fold region is inactive (#2041).

ipad-13.notes: Required when the app ships on iPad. Dual-pane screens are the point.

android-phone.notes: Raw emulator captures (1080x2400) exceed Play's 2:1 rule; always compose onto this canvas. 9:16 at 1080 is the featuring bar. JPEG/PNG-24, no alpha, 8MB.

android-tablet-landscape.notes: 10-inch slot. Landscape layout: text zone left, device right.

play-feature-graphic.notes: Required for featuring consideration. Type + field only, no screenshot.
